name: OpenSubtitles
summary: Finds subtitle tracks for the episode you are watching.
description: Searches OpenSubtitles for subtitles matching the episode and hands the text straight to the player, already converted for the browser. Needs your own API key — downloads count against your account's daily quota, so it asks for one track per language rather than everything it can find.

api_key.description: Your OpenSubtitles API key, from their consumer dashboard. Downloads count against your quota.

languages.description: Comma-separated language codes, best first. One track is fetched per language.

trusted_only.description: Only use uploads marked trusted. Fewer results, fewer mistimed files.

user_agent.description: Identifies this client to OpenSubtitles, as their API requires.
